rows.query: What is the rule of origin for HS 8414.59 under the EU-UK Trade and Cooperation Agreement?

rule_text: CTSH: All non-originating materials used in the production of the good have undergone a change in tariff classification at the 6-digit level (subheading).
A maximum of 50% of the ex-works price (EXW) is made up of non-originating parts (MAXNOM).

result.note: Same rules on both sides of the TCA. 'criteria' are the alternatives evaluate_origin can check (any one is enough); those in 'not_machine_readable' must be checked by hand.

rows.answer:
Rule of origin of HS 8414.59 under the TCA:
Any one of these is enough: the change of tariff subheading (CTSH); non-originating materials up to 50 % of the EXW price (MaxNOM).
General tolerance: 10 % of the ex-works price.

rows.query: ¿Qué regla de origen se aplica a los muebles de madera de cocina (SA 9403.40) que exportamos a Corea del Sur?

rule_sets.heading: ex Chapter 94
rule_sets.subdivision: Furniture; bedding, mattresses, mattress supports, cushions and similar stuffed furnishings; lamps and lighting fittings, not elsewhere specified or included; illuminated signs, illuminated name-plates and the like; prefabricated buildings
rule_text: Manufacture from materials of any heading, except that of the product.
Manufacture in which the value of all the materials used does not exceed 40% of the ex-works price of the product.

result.note: Rules of the UK's agreement with the same partner, which mirrors the EU one; the EU annex on EUR-Lex is the legal text. 'criteria' are the alternatives evaluate_origin can check (any one is enough); those in 'not_machine_readable' must be checked by hand.

rows.answer:
Regla de origen de SA 9403.40 en el acuerdo UE-Corea:
Basta con cumplir una de estas: el cambio de partida (CTH); materiales no originarios hasta el 40 % del precio franco fábrica (MaxNOM).
Tolerancia general: 10 % del precio franco fábrica.

rows.query: Código TARIC 8708 99 97 90: ¿qué regla de origen tiene para exportar a Japón?

rule_text: CTH: All non-originating materials used in the production of the good have undergone a change in tariff classification at the 4-digit level (tariff heading).
A maximum of 50% of the ex-works price (EXW) is made up of non-originating parts (MAXNOM).
Your goods contain a Regional Value Content (RVC) of at least 55% of the Free on Board (FOB) cost of the goods.

result.note: Rules of the UK's agreement with the same partner, which mirrors the EU one; the EU annex on EUR-Lex is the legal text. 'criteria' are the alternatives evaluate_origin can check (any one is enough); those in 'not_machine_readable' must be checked by hand.

rows.answer:
Regla de origen de 8708.99 97 90 en el acuerdo UE-Japón:
Basta con cumplir una de estas: el cambio de partida (CTH); materiales no originarios hasta el 50 % del precio franco fábrica (MaxNOM); contenido de valor regional de al menos el 55 % (FOB) (RVC).
Tolerancia general: 10 % del precio franco fábrica.

rule_text: CTH: All non-originating materials used in the production of the good have undergone a change in tariff classification at the 4-digit level (tariff heading).

A change from within any one of these heading, whether or not there is also a change from any other heading, provided that the value of non-originating materials classified in the same heading as the final product does not exceed 50% of the transaction value or ex-works price of the product.

rows.query: What does REX stand for in EU customs, and who needs to register?
rows.answer: REX stands for «Registre d'Entreprise de Qualité » (Exporter of Origin Register). It is the EU's official register for approved exporters under the EU-Canada CETA. To be checked under CETA, the exporter has to be registered in REX: the country code, followed by the exporter's own number, like ESREX123456789.

rows.query: ¿Qué diferencia hay entre los criterios CTH y CTSH en las reglas de origen?
rows.answer: Los criterios de la regla de origen de un producto son el cambio de partida (CTH) y el cambio de partida y subpartida (CTSH). El cambio de partida (CTH) se cumple si todos los materiales no originarios provienen de una partida (una de las 200 de la lista de HS) y el producto lo hace. El cambio de partida y subpartida (CTSH) lo cumple si el producto lo hace y los materiales no originarios provienen de una subpartida (una parte de una partida). El cambio de partida y subpartida es más exigente.

rows.query: What is the difference between an ex-works price and a FOB price?
rows.answer: The ex-works price (EXW) is the price the seller receives when it delivers the goods to a carrier, ready for loading at the seller's premises. The FOB price is the price the seller receives when it delivers the goods to the carrier at the port of origin, ready for loading. The FOB price is usually higher than the EXW price.

rows.query: ¿Qué es la tolerancia general en las reglas de origen preferencial?
rows.answer: La tolerancia general (TG) es el conjunto de materiales no originarios que se permite que un producto lleve sin perder su origen preferencial. Su valor se expresa en el precio franco fábrica (EXW) y se suma al valor de los materiales originarios para calcular el porcentaje de materiales no originarios.
